title: Review follow-ups of PR #37902: the Knowledge page's Test connection button moves with the Turso fields it checks
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ① follow-up of a merged-or-landing PR (L1/L2 follow-ups of PR #37902, one card per PR, items ticked per the review-follow-ups exception) · Source: topic #37000
Grading: area:ai · domain:server · Task · p3 · reach: the Knowledge settings page on a PostgreSQL deployment (contract record 7215949880 ③ and N1, measured on the handler's no-URL answer) · evidence: read.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue "PR #37902"` → 1 hit (#37678, the card the PR fixes); `is:issue "Test connection" knowledge` → 10 hits, open ones #37678 and #37680 (neither moves the button; #24769 closed, it registered the handler). Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after #37902 merges, sequenced with #37680 (same Turso group; whichever is claimed second runs overlap-check against the other).

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：PostgreSQL 部署的知识设置页上还留着「测试连接」按钮，它只检查已经不在页上的 Turso 字段；把按钮跟着 Turso 字段一起搬到 Turso 存储那边。顺带两个复审小项。
- 谁受益：PostgreSQL 部署的管理员不会看到一个跟本部署无关的按钮。
- 不做会怎样：按钮还在，点了只回一句「没配置 Turso URL」，内容属实、不改任何东西。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

PR #37902 (Fixes #37678, #37679) moves the Turso group out of `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/knowledge.manifest.ts` into `@objectstack/knowledge-turso`'s settings contribution. Three review items from L1-a ACCEPT 7215975557 and contract record 7215949880 remain:

- [ ] **N1 — Test connection.** The button and its `knowledgeTestActionHandler` registration stay on the base page, so on a page without the Turso fields it checks fields the page does not show. Move both into knowledge-turso's contribution (option B in the dev report on #37678, 7215704211), so a pgvector page has no Turso check; move the test-door pins with it.
- [ ] **N2 — silent no-contribution.** `KnowledgeTursoPlugin.init()` discards the boolean `contributeKnowledgeTursoSettings` returns. When it is false while the store still reads from settings, the store opens its default file with no log line. Warn on `false` under `opensFromSettings()`.
- [ ] **N3 — the stored token's secret row.** The new changeset's tidy sentence names the `knowledge` setting rows but not the `sys_secret` row a saved `turso_auth_token` points at; without the store no API door clears it. Add the clause (on the changeset if still pending, else on `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`).

## Acceptance

- On a deployment without knowledge-turso's store-from-settings, the Knowledge page shows no Test connection action and `POST /api/settings/knowledge/test` answers as for an undeclared action; with it, the action is on the page and answers as today. Pins in both cases.
- A false contribution under `opensFromSettings()` logs one warning; pinned.
- The tidy text names the `sys_secret` row.

Blocked-by: #37902
